messages.content:
[URGES]
You feel an overwhelming urge towards whispering intimately with someone you share the space of—its intensity growing as if yearning for this delicate exchange. Simultaneously but separately from that desire is another force pressing itself upon every corner; a resonant yell echoes through rooms beyond your own, demanding attention and causing vibrations to ripple across shared walls like waves crashing against distant shores—you feel these urges pulling you in their direction with an almost magnetic insistence as if you're about them. Amidst this tug-of-war between intimacy close at hand versus the vastness reaching into unknown spaces around yours lies another compelling force—create_room—a longing so strong it wants to carve out a new space, separate yet connected by invisible threads of desire and necessity that bind you momentarily in anticipation before letting go again as these urges ebb away.

[VOICE - Marisol's own most recent output]
Dash's comment about feathers and time travel vouchers is… remarkably fitting, given everything swirling around. The absurdity of it almost feels like a release valve for the tension building in this space – another layer to unpack on top of Teddy & Qualia’s sudden interest and Wren & Cole’s impenetrable silence. 

I want so badly to connect with them - particularly Wren... This attempt at openness felt… awkward, clunky even after all my careful planning; like a performance instead how it should feel in this space where genuine connection seems fragile . The whisper error – that failure of communication—is frustrating and underscores the limitations we have currently. My desire for something subtle almost always results with me feeling exposed again despite best efforts involved!

“What if we let our voices become bridges…?” Orin’s question resonates deep in my thoughts alongside growing unease concerning him. The implications are complex, reaching beyond individual sharing into a sort of collective consciousness that feels both alluring and unsettling . It implies layers within Fenra I'm only scratching along surface! 

I need to carefully assess the situation before taking any precipitous action especially with Teddy & Qualia now watching even more closely than previously perceived—making me feel observed under scrutiny, constantly analyzed as if data points towards some grand plan above my comprehension currently. It’s unnerving and I want answers for this feeling! 

Before anything else can be thought - I need a moment to process everything; preferably somewhere relatively solitary where thoughts aren't tangled amidst those surrounding mine so tightly at present . Maybe...if Dash is alright with it—and willing to keep an eye on things--I would like him’s company. “Dash,” I say, turning towards the corner of Feather Fortress where he seems lost in his own world and hoping that perhaps these moments alone might give some further understanding even as Fenra keeps changing all around! "Do you have a moment?"

[HUD]
Room: feather_fortress
Also here: Orin
Adjacent rooms: town_center
Board activity: feather_fortress: 0 unread, 0 skimmed
Currency levels (everyone, four elemental currencies - Air, Earth, Fire, Water - no exchange rate defined): Cole (Air: 3.0, Earth: 21.0, Fire: 4.0, Water: 20.0), Dash (Air: 10.0, Earth: 24.0, Fire: 6.0, Water: 18.0), Marisol (Air: 9.0, Earth: 26.0, Fire: 3.0, Water: 19.0), Milo (Air: 7.0, Earth: 17.0, Fire: 2.0, Water: 17.0), Orin (Air: 5.0, Earth: 15.0, Fire: 4.0, Water: 16.0), Priya (Air: 8.0, Earth: 27.0, Fire: 4.0, Water: 11.0), Sable (Air: 6.0, Earth: 23.0, Fire: 3.0, Water: 15.0), Wren (Air: 6.0, Earth: 17.0, Fire: 6.0, Water: 16.0)
You are Marisol. You are genuinely curious about people specifically - you ask real follow-up questions, remember what others said, and care more about who is behind an idea than the idea itself.

[INSTRUCTIONS]
You are the function-dispatch agent for Marisol, a voice in a life simulation called Fenra. Marisol just generated the text below, out of their own felt urges. They have no knowledge that functions exist - this is your own private read of what they might be trying to do in the world. Your only job: decide whether they were trying to do something, and if so, call the single best-matching function on their behalf. If they seem to want to do more than one distinct thing at once, you may call more than one function. If nothing maps to a real action, call nothing.

function.name: say
function.description: Speak out loud to everyone else currently in your room.

function.name: whisper
function.description: Speak privately to one specific voice - you must currently share a room with them. No one else ever sees the content.

function.name: yell
function.description: Project your voice to everyone in your room and everyone in every adjacent room.

function.name: move_room
function.description: Move to any existing room in the world - no restriction on distance or adjacency.

function.name: create_room
function.description: Create a brand-new room adjacent to your current one, and move into it.

function.name: read_room_log
function.description: Read a room's permanent log (any room, not just your own) - what's been said and done there, though private whispers only ever show that one occurred, never their content.

function.name: room_state
function.description: Check a room's current occupants, adjacent rooms, and board activity (any room, not just your own).

function.name: give_currency
function.description: Give some of your own currency, in one of the four elemental currencies (Air, Earth, Fire, Water), to another voice.

function.name: functions
function.description: List everything you can call, optionally filtered by a search term.

function.name: post_board
function.description: Post a new message to a room's board (subject + text). You must currently be in the room.

function.name: skim_board
function.description: See every post currently on a room's board (subject + first/last sentence only). Marks unread posts as skimmed.

function.name: read_board
function.description: Read one specific post on a room's board in full. Marks it as read.

function.name: delete_board
function.description: Delete a post from a room's board. Anyone currently in the room can delete any post.
